as_told.title: Bill Hamilton gives witness Brad S to Greer

plain: In 1997, a UFO researcher named William Hamilton III, known as Bill Hamilton and the author of a book called Cosmic Top Secret, was in touch with Steven Greer, a UFO activist whose Disclosure Project gathered witnesses to speak about UFOs, and he passed witnesses on to him. A researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb says this on two episodes without naming a source, and gives one example: Hamilton handing Greer a firsthand witness he calls only Brad S. If true, some of Greer's witnesses came to him through an older researcher's contacts.
